name: ElementSet
caption: Set Element

configuration.description: A single SmartField placeholder pointing to the output of a Create Element step, e.g. "{{CreateTotalElement_Total}}". Must be wrapped in {{ }} and must not contain a dotted path. Read unresolved (raw) at run time.

New content of the slot. Value elements: any SmartText (resolved before storing); empty clears the slot. Reference elements: exactly one {{name}} placeholder resolving to an upstream Reference output of the same table.

The element's type, resolved from elementSelector by the editor and persisted. The run time trusts this key alone: "reference" stores a record reference, anything else (including missing or empty) stores text.
Table number of the target element (0 for Value elements or when unresolved). Written by the editor; not used at run time.

notes: Overwrites the element's single slot (keyed by the bare selector name, no [index]); it never appends.

The live status line is advisory: it shows problems while you edit but does not stop the dialog from saving. Nothing re-checks it at publish; only the generic dangling-reference warning applies there. When writing JSON by hand, set derivedType/derivedTableNo yourself and make sure they match the Create Element step.

The editor derives derivedType/derivedTableNo when the dialog is saved. If the selector cannot be resolved at that moment, it writes derivedType "" and derivedTableNo 0, and the value is then stored as text.
Status messages are shown with the field prefix 'Element: ' or 'Value: ' as listed. When valid the status reads '✓ Value' or '✓ Reference: <table caption> (<table no>)'.
